attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (GUI) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The binary is the legitimate Microsoft Windows "WMI Standard Event Consumer - scripting" (scrcons.exe). Its purpose is to act as a COM server that can be registered as a service to execute scripts in response to WMI events. It correctly implements functions to handle command-line registration (`/REGSERVER`, `/UNREGSERVER`), service installation (`CreateServiceW`), and script execution via WMI (`RunScriptText`, `IndicateToConsumer`). The presence of the descriptive string `<description>WMI Standard Event Consumer - scripting</description>` further confirms its identity. Although this binary is frequently abused by malware as a LOLBin for persistence, the file itself is a benign system component.
